# Tarot Italia
> Consulenze simboliche, evolutive e previsionali dei Tarocchi con Maria Teresa Rogani, Operatore Olistico (L. 4/2013). Studio a Macerata e sessioni online in chiamata vocale.

Tarot Italia is the public site of Maria Teresa Rogani. The practice combines cartomanzia and tarologia evolutiva with all 78 Arcani (Maggiori e Minori). Consultations respect free will and do not replace medical, psychological, or legal advice.

## Key facts
- Practitioner: Maria Teresa Rogani · Operatore Olistico
- Brand: Tarot Italia
- Email: info@tarotitalia.com
- Phone / WhatsApp / Telegram: +39 379 103 82 53
- Studio: Via Crispi 37, 62100 Macerata, Italia
- P.IVA: 02136780430
- Booking: WhatsApp (online payment / Stripe currently paused — Maria sends payment details manually)
- Online sessions: voice call only
- In person: Macerata by appointment (until 18:00); from 19:00 online only
- Typical public slots: 09:00–20:00 Europe/Rome

## Consultation prices (EUR)
- Consulto Breve · 20 min · €19 · online only
- Consulto Essenziale · 45 min · €50 · online or in person
- Consulto Evolutivo Completo · 60 min · €75 · online or in person (recommended)
- Sessione Integrata · 90 min · €90 · online or in person
Every session includes Maggiori and Minori.
